description: Build a from-scratch, no-build static tic-tac-toe app and prove it with a Playwright video. The canonical record/headless example.

task.title: Build a playable tic-tac-toe game
request: Build a tic-tac-toe game as a single static web app (index.html + a JS file,
no framework, no build step) that two players can play in the browser:
- A 3x3 grid the players click to place X then O, alternating.
- Detect and announce the winner (or a draw), and offer a reset.
- Use accessible, user-facing markup so a Playwright test can drive it with
In the QA/validation stage, write and run a Playwright end-to-end test that
plays a full game to a win in a real browser, with video + trace ON, and
